rationale: Retain one canonical Phoenix Renewables manager-level operating-renewables portfolio and the existing ArcLight Capital Partners / Fund VIII ownership period. ArcLight Capital is the census's shortened label for the same manager, so the queued ADD_OWNER is superseded and no duplicate ownership row is created. Current ArcLight sources support Fund VIII attribution, Phoenix's manager-level boundary, U.S. geography and active status, but no direct source supports the existing 2024 ownership-entry year or a Phoenix headquarters. Correct both to null. Correct the existing milestones so the July 2024 SkyVest launch is not misrepresented as a Phoenix acquisition or as a release that itself named Phoenix.

identityResolution.managerLevelBoundary: Phoenix is the Fund VIII operating-renewables portfolio. SkyVest is its management and operating-services platform; Thunderbird is a separate portfolio; individual projects and subsidiaries beneath Phoenix are not separate PortCos.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: Retain the existing Phoenix record; do not merge it with SkyVest, Thunderbird or a project.

ownershipResolution.managerAliasDecision: Resolve ArcLight Capital to the existing ArcLight Capital Partners organization.

operatingResolution.reportedScale: ArcLight's 2025 ESG report reports 467 MW for Phoenix Renewables.

acquisitionExitCheck.skyVestLaunch: ArcLight launched SkyVest Renewables on July 29, 2024; this is a management-platform milestone, not proof of Phoenix's ownership closing.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentOwnership: ArcLight's live investments page marks Phoenix Current, and its portfolio-services page identifies Phoenix as a Fund VIII portfolio managed through SkyVest.
acquisitionExitCheck.assetLevelActivity: A July 2026 FERC application concerns a Northwest Ohio asset-level add-on beneath the portfolio and does not change Phoenix's manager-level ownership.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: No Phoenix-level completed sale, signed pending exit, dissolution, successor or rename was identified through 2026-08-14.

unresolvedQuestions: Phoenix's exact legal-entity suffix, website, headquarters, founding date, ownership-entry date and ArcLight stake are not publicly disclosed.
